newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHARES EXTEND GAINS, CHAIN LEADS.
newsitem.headline: SHARES EXTEND GAINS, CHAIN LEADS.

text.p: Latvian shares extended their recent gains on Thursday and dealers were cautiously optimistic that the bourse was rebounding as new investors enter the market.
Total turnover was 101,000 lats versus 63,000 lats on Wednesday and the Rietumu index inched up 1.18 percent to 183.4.
Secondary list stock Daugavpils Chain was the most active share in trade of 24,300 lats at the unchanged price of 2.31 lats.
Four of the five official list stocks gained with only the Riga Transport Fleet holding steady at 1.28 lats.
Unibanka was the most active official list share in trade of 18,700 lats and it rose to 3.21 lats from 3.16 lats.
"Trade seems to be picking up, but we will have to wait two or three sessions to see if it is a trend," one dealer said.
"There are new investors coming to the market and prices are low," he added.
